events.verdict: Braun (DEN) reaches across and initiates contact with Barnes' (TOR) right shoulder, affecting his shot attempt near the basket.
Barnes (TOR) firms up in his legally obtained defensive position and when the incidental contact occurs with Gordon (DEN), he turns as a result of the contact.
Porter Jr. (DEN) gathers the ball against his side and illegally restarts his dribble.
Braun (DEN) maintains a legal guarding position during Barrett's (TOR) drive to the basket.
Barrett (TOR) steps out of bounds at the end of his drive to the basket.
Jokic (DEN) makes a legal offensive move as he spins towards the basket.

Jokic (DEN) lowers his arm naturally as he pursues the rebound and there is contact to Barnes' (TOR) head.  Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Braun (DEN) grasps and quickly releases Barrett's (TOR) jersey, allowing him to move freely.
Westbrook (DEN) reaches in and initiates illegal contact to Agbaji's (TOR) arm.
Braun (DEN) commits a take foul on Mitchell (TOR).
Murray (DEN) initiates contact to Dick's (TOR) elbow, affecting his driving shot attempt.
Agbaji (TOR) initiates contact to Gordon's (DEN) arm affecting his dunk attempt.
Jokic (DEN) is not in a legal guarding position at the time of the contact with Mitchell (TOR), affecting his driving shot attempt.
Braun (DEN) legally contests Barrett's (TOR) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
